svg.title: Prim's algorithm — animated state and partner table
svg.desc: Animated SVG. Left panel: hexagonal graph view of Prim's algorithm running on a 6-vertex graph, showing which vertices are in S, which edges are in A, which edges currently cross the cut, and which edge was most recently added. Right panel: the partner[v] table for every v in V \ S, with the lightest partner highlighted as the next pick. The animation cycles indefinitely.

g.text: V \ S = ∅ — A is the MST
